question_text: Each row of samples has exactly three positive integers. Construct repeated_in_row(samples, r) in Python to return the value occurring at least twice in row r, or 0 if all are different.
adaptation_rationale: Same three-way pair selection reasoning; positive-domain sentinel made explicit; all 27 test case combinations checked.

marking_points.criterion: Reads the three values from specified row.
Handles equality of first and second or first and third.
Handles equality of second and third.
Returns repeated value correctly(including all same), otherwise 0.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct wording or valid implementation earning the specified independent points.
partial_credit_notes: Award each stated point independently up to the total; do not double-credit the same idea.

verification.technical: Concrete marking points independently reasoned from the defined context and exact 2027 scope.
verification.code_check: Executable checks saved under checks/ where applicable.

test_code:
import itertools
for row in itertools.product(range(1,4),repeat=3):
 expected=next((x for x in row if row.count(x)>1),0)
 assert repeated_in_row([row],0)==expected
